translations.web: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
translations.bsb: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
translations.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
translations.asv: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
